Privacy Policy

Provisional version, under legal review. Last updated: 28 September 2026.

Who is responsible for your data

Zafira Limited Edition S.A.S., NIT 902064015-7, Cl 68 # 57-21, Of. 201, Bogotá D.C., Colombia · business@zafiramatchagency.com · +57 310 688 3682. Zafira is the controller of the personal data collected through this site, under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012.

What data we collect

  • • Gentlemen’s application: name, email, phone or WhatsApp, age, occupation, city and country, and availability to travel.
  • • Candidate registration: personal details, marital status, profession, education, English level, optional social media profiles, expectations and the authorisations given.
  • • Contact form: name, email and message.
  • • Evaluation payment: name and email. Payment details are processed by PayPal; Zafira does not receive or store card details.

What we use it for

  • • To review applications and registrations and to contact you.
  • • To verify identity, marital status and background, including through specialised providers, some of them located in the United States.
  • • To provide the service, manage payments and meet legal obligations.
  • • To measure how the site is used, only if you accept analytics cookies.

Sensitive data is processed only when necessary and with your express authorisation. You are not obliged to authorise the processing of sensitive data.

Who we share it with

We do not sell personal data. We share it only with the providers needed to run the site and provide the service — web hosting, email, Google (analytics with your consent, and web fonts), PayPal (payments), background verification providers, and WhatsApp if you choose to write to us — or when the law requires it. Some of these providers are located outside Colombia, mainly in the United States.

Cookies

  • • Essential: a cookie that stores your consent choice.
  • • Analytics: Google Analytics, only if you accept it in the cookie banner.
  • • You can change your choice at any time from the preferences button in the banner.

Retention and security

We keep data for as long as needed for these purposes and to meet legal obligations, and we apply reasonable technical and administrative security measures. The site uses HTTPS.

Your rights

You may access, update and correct your data, request proof of your authorisation, ask how your data has been used, withdraw your authorisation or request deletion where applicable, and file a complaint with the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio. Write to business@zafiramatchagency.com. Enquiries are answered within 10 business days and claims within 15 business days, as provided by Law 1581 of 2012.

Adults only

Our services are intended only for people of legal age.
